description:
A collection of all the members in the chat. Nullable.

TIP: Lists members of a Teams chat (scoped to a user's view of the chat). Each member has @odata.type (aadUserConversationMember | anonymousGuestConversationMember), id, displayName, userId (for AAD members — null for guests), email, roles (owner | guest), tenantId (for federated participants from other tenants). Federated / guest participants help identify external communications during investigations. Supports $filter, $top, $skip.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.
